name: Dan J. Itzen
occupation: Natrona County district attorney (re-elected November 2026). Oil City News reported that he said he has been a prosecutor with the office since 1999 and was seeking his third term.
prior_offices: Prosecutor, Natrona County District Attorney's Office (from 1999, as he stated at a July 8, 2026, Politics in the Park forum reported by Oil City News); Natrona County district attorney (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Daniel J. Itzen, also listed as Dan J. Itzen, is the Natrona County district attorney and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. Oil City News reported that at a July 8, 2026, Politics in the Park forum he said he has been a prosecutor with the office since 1999, was seeking his third term, and that the office handles about 3,000 cases a year.
